Book professional solo performers from Krishna Music School Pushkar for refined, intimate, and versatile live experiences. Sitar (Classical String)

Hindustani Classical ₹22K-35K

Artist: Classical Sitar Specialist (Associate) | Styles: Traditional raga recital (alaap → jod → jhala format), meditative ambient (yoga/spa), fusion crossover (contemporary backing), Bollywood adaptations (film songs on sitar)

Repertoire by Time:

  • Morning Ragas: Bhairav, Todi (dawn ceremonies, breakfast ambiance, morning yoga sessions—purity freshness)
  • Evening Ragas: Yaman, Kafi, Desh (sunset performances, evening receptions—romantic contemplative mood)
  • Anytime Ragas: Bhairavi, Khamaj (flexible programming, accessible to non-classical audiences)
  • Popular Adaptations: Bollywood melodies on sitar (raga-based film songs—bridging classical and popular)

Typical Setlist (60-Min Classical):

  • Alaap (15 mins): Slow meditative note exploration in Raga Yaman (introducing raga personality, building atmosphere)
  • Jod (15 mins): Rhythmic patterns without tabla (building momentum, showcasing right-hand technique)
  • Gat with Tabla Track (20 mins): Structured composition with rhythm (dynamic interplay, peak engagement)
  • Closing Jhala (10 mins): Fast drone-string showcase, high-energy finale (exciting climax, audience awakened)

Ideal For: Luxury hotel lobby installations, spiritual retreat concerts, meditation festival performances, private music salon gatherings, cultural tourism showcases

Performance Formats: Five Signature Styles

From lounge ambiance to devotional concerts—each format tailored for specific contexts and audience expectations.

🍸 Lounge & Sundowner Sets

Context: Hotel lawns, resort terraces, rooftop bars, poolside evenings, cocktail receptions

Characteristics:

  • Volume: Background to mid-level (conversation-friendly, not overpowering guests)
  • Repertoire: Mix of Bollywood classics, light Sufi, instrumental interludes, occasional English pop
  • Interaction: Minimal (artist available for requests, brief song introductions, otherwise unobtrusive elegance)
  • Dress Code: Smart casual to semi-formal (kurta-pajama, ethnic-chic, or western formal depending on venue)

Typical Structure (90-Min Sundowner):

  • 6:00-6:30 PM: Soft instrumental/raga-based opening (as sun sets, creating magical golden hour mood)
  • 6:30-7:15 PM: Bollywood romantic classics + light devotionals (emotional nostalgic core)
  • 7:15-7:30 PM: Closing with uplifting pieces or guest requests (ending on satisfied high note)

Pricing: ₹18,000-28,000 depending on artist type, location, equipment needs

🕉️ Devotional & Sufi Concerts

Context: Temple courtyards, spiritual retreat halls, meditation festival evenings, ghats, ashrams

Characteristics:

  • Volume: Moderate (contemplative, allows introspection, not blasting—sacred appropriate)
  • Repertoire: Bhajans, Sufi poetry (Kabir, Khusro, Meera), mantra chanting, raga-based devotionals
  • Interaction: Moderate (song meanings explained, invite meditation/reflection, possible kirtan call-response)
  • Dress Code: Traditional devotional (white kurta or traditional attire, respectful sacred setting)

Typical Structure (60-Min Devotional):

  • Opening: Meditative raga alaap or Om chanting (settling audience into sacred contemplative space)
  • Core: 5-7 bhajans/Sufi songs (building devotional intensity gradually, emotional journey)
  • Interactive Segment: Kirtan call-response (audience participation, collective devotional energy)
  • Closing: Peaceful mantra or blessing song (leaving audience in contemplative peaceful state)

Audience Experience: Many report emotional release (tears common during devotional concerts), feeling of inner peace, spiritual opening, cathartic healing

Pricing: ₹15,000-25,000 (spiritual venues often have lower budgets—we accommodate accordingly)

🎤 Bollywood Unplugged (Interactive)

Context: Wedding sangeet nights, hotel theme evenings, corporate informal gatherings, private celebration parties

Characteristics:

  • Volume: Foreground (audience actively listening, singing along, not just background ambiance)
  • Repertoire: Bollywood hits (old + new), film song mashups, retro medleys, romantic duets
  • Interaction: High (take requests, teach choruses, invite audience singing, dedications welcomed enthusiastically)
  • Dress Code: Colorful festive (bright kurtas, Indo-western fusion, party-appropriate celebratory)

Typical Structure (75-Min Bollywood):

  • Opening: Upbeat classic (Ek Pardesi—instant recognition, energy up immediately)
  • Romantic Segment: 5-6 love songs (Tum Hi Ho, Tujhe Dekha To—emotional connection depth)
  • Retro Medley: 10-min nostalgic journey (Kishore/Lata/Rafi era—multigenerational appeal)
  • Interactive: Teach simple chorus, invite audience to sing (Chaiyya Chaiyya—participation peak)
  • Requests: 15 mins fulfilling audience song requests (personalized responsive experience)
  • Closing: High-energy dance number or emotional ballad (based on reading crowd mood)

Audience Experience: Guests singing along loudly, phone recording videos, dedications for couples, laughter, nostalgia, joyful uninhibited celebration

Pricing: ₹18,000-28,000 (similar to lounge but more energy expenditure, higher engagement)

🎓 Classical/Folk Feature (Educational)

Context: Cultural tourism events, university music departments, art festivals, museum programs, connoisseur gatherings

Characteristics:

  • Volume: Moderate foreground (audience focused listening, appreciating nuance and subtlety)
  • Repertoire: Classical ragas (Yaman, Bhairav), folk songs with cultural explanations, instrument demonstrations
  • Interaction: Educational (explain raga theory, demonstrate taal, share cultural stories, Q&A possible)
  • Dress Code: Traditional formal (classical musician attire, respectful to art form tradition)

Typical Structure (60-Min Educational Concert):

  • Introduction (5 mins): Artist self-intro, explain format, set educational context expectations
  • Raga Demonstration (20 mins): Perform raga with explanations (this is alaap, this is gat, note relationships)
  • Folk Feature (15 mins): 2-3 folk songs with cultural stories (when sung, by whom, what life occasions)
  • Instrument Talk (10 mins): Show instrument parts, playing techniques, answer curious questions
  • Performance Finale (10 mins): Full raga or folk piece without interruption (pure uninterrupted musical experience)

Audience Experience: Deep appreciation for complexity, “I never understood raga before!”, cultural insight revelation, intellectual artistic satisfaction

Pricing: ₹20,000-35,000 (educational component adds value, institutions often pay premium for quality expertise)

🎯 Workshop + Mini Concert Combo

Context: Retreat groups, school/college music programs, corporate team-building, music therapy settings

Structure:

  • Part 1 (45-60 mins): Interactive workshop (teach basics of instrument, simple raga, rhythm patterns, participants try hands-on)
  • Part 2 (30-45 mins): Concert demonstration (artist performs virtuosically, showcasing what was just taught in action, inspiring participants)

Learning Outcomes: Participants gain appreciation for instrument difficulty, understand basic music theory concepts, connect intellectually + emotionally with performance

Pricing: ₹25,000-40,000 (workshop + performance combo, educational value justifies premium pricing)

Technical Requirements: Simple Logistics

Solo artists = minimal setup, maximum flexibility. Here’s what we need for smooth seamless performance.

📐 Space Requirements

  • Footprint: 6×6 ft clear area minimum (compact—fits anywhere even tight spaces)
  • Seating: 1 armless chair for sitar/harmonium players (backless stool works too)
  • Floor: Flat stable surface (wooden stage ideal, carpet/tiles acceptable, avoid uneven grass for instrument stability)
  • Placement: Flexible—corner alcove, stage center, garden spot—we adapt gracefully

⚡ Power & Sound

  • Power: Stable 220V near stage area, single 5A/15A point sufficient (minimal electrical load)
  • Sound System: 2-channel mixer minimum, 1-2 vocal mics, DI box for keys/guitar (basic PA adequate)
  • Monitors: 1 floor wedge or small inbuilt monitor works (artist needs to hear themselves clearly)
  • We Can Provide: Small portable PA for intimate venues (<50 people—included in pricing if needed)

💡 Lighting & Ambiance

  • Basic: Warm wash/spot light illuminating artist (no fancy production needed—simplicity elegant)
  • Optional Enhancements: Candles, fairy lights, lanterns for romantic ambiance (we coordinate with your décor team)
  • Outdoor Considerations: If evening/night outdoor, lighting essential for artist to see instrument (music stand light backup)

⏱️ Setup & Timing

  • Arrival: 45-60 mins before performance start for setup + soundcheck (punctual professional arrival)
  • Typical Sets: 2 × 30-40 mins OR 1 × 60-75 mins (flexible—we adapt to your event flow)
  • Volume: Background or foreground—we match your requirement and read room energy adjusting
  • Outdoor Readiness: Weather/cover considerations handled (rain backup plan discussed advance, instruments protected)
